title: Live helper smoke test + docs cutover to tk herd
description: Two parts. (1) Live smoke, inside herdr: scripted scenario (scripts/verify-herd-helper.sh or Go integration test gated on HERDR_ENV) that runs a 2-tick toy epic in a scratch repo end-to-end using ONLY tk herd spawn/wait/collect/cleanup + git merge + tk closes — assert the wave loop is at most 5 helper invocations per wave, assert no polling (wait returns via events), then kill -9 the driving process mid-wave and prove tk herd reconcile yields a correct plan and the run completes without losing worker output; capture evidence to a field-report file docs/design/herd-helper-smoke-report.md. (2) Docs cutover: update skills/ticks/references/herdr-runner.md to present tk herd as the primary mechanism (interim manual fan-in demoted to fallback), update runners-config.md/herdr-kinds.md cross-references where behavior is now enforced by the helper, and add the helper smoke command to .tick/config.md Closeout Evidence Commands via the ORCHESTRATOR (report the exact line; do not edit .tick/ yourself — flag it in your report for the orchestrator to apply). Fold every real-behavior deviation found back into docs or code within this tick.
notes: 2026-08-11 15:10 - Dispatch requirement (human-approved): every herd command must return explicit ExitError for its exit codes — never rely on GetExitCode message-substring classification (known to misread "invalid argument" dial errors as usage exit 2). Pattern established in herd_wait.go (tick 9z6).
acceptance_criteria: Smoke scenario passes live with kill -9 recovery demonstrated and report committed; herdr-runner.md presents tk herd as primary; wave loop <=5 helper calls asserted; all deviations folded back
